title: The 10 elements
and the
aircon remote
tag_line: Send this to the one who hides the remote.

Wood.yang: Checks under every cushion, one by one.
Wood.yin: Puts it back on its hook. Every time.

Fire.yang: Set it to 18. Says nothing. Wears a hoodie.
Fire.yin: Wants it at 25 and a blanket anyway.

Earth.yang: Always knows where it is. Never tells.
Earth.yin: Found it in the fridge. Doesn't ask why.

Metal.yang: Bought a second remote. Problem solved.
Metal.yin: Labels the remote. And the batteries.

Water.yang: Uses the app on the phone. Who needs it?
Water.yin: Just opens the windows. Fresh air.

comment_line: Who controls the aircon at home? Comment below.
caption:
Send this to the one who always hides the aircon remote ❄️

The remote is gone, the room is at 18 and every element reacts in its own way: one searches every cushion, one bought a spare, one just opens the windows. Which one are you, and who do you live with?

Your element comes from the day you were born, not your zodiac animal. Find yours free at the link in bio.
